about_the_game:
Welcome to Train Cargo Simulator!

Every day, trains arrive with crates full of mixed goods. unload them swiftly, sort their contents with precision, and prepare every order exactly as required. The company counts on efficiency, and all valued workers are always dependable.

Move incoming crates from wagons into the warehouse without delay.

Unpack and organize goods at your workbench, assembling orders exactly as specified.

Maintain strict order in storage and ensure all outgoing cargo departs on schedule.

The smoother you perform, the less work lingers once the lights off.

Why It Matters

  • Efficient Workflow – Every second saved keeps the company running flawlessly… and  everything in its place.

  • Accurate Orders – Each perfect shipment reinforces the company’s reputation and any mistake leaves a trace.

  • Growing Demands – More trains, more orders, more responsibility… the company’s expectations never stop grow.

  • Valued Contribution – Your productivity strengthens the company, and nothing goes unnoticed.

Success here means order, timing, and discipline. Ensure the yard never slows down.

At Train Cargo Simulator, you’re more than just an employee—you’re a vital part of a finely tuned system. Keep working hard, stay efficient, and prove you are worthy of the company’s trust. After all, a reliable worker is the most valuable cargo of all.

Wishlist today, and begin your career in efficiency. 🚂

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
